001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventFactor;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventIntel;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseFactorTooltip;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI.TooltipCreator;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
012
013public class SDRArroyoFactor extends BaseEventFactor {
014        
015        public SDRArroyoFactor() {
016        }
017
018        @Override
019        public boolean shouldShow(BaseEventIntel intel) {
020                return true;
021        }
022        
023        @Override
024        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(final BaseEventIntel intel) {
025                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
026                        @Override
027                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
028                                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
029                                tooltip.addPara("Rayan Arroyo's network of gray-market contacts, rogue traders, and countless front companies allows him to deliver "
030                                                        + "sensitive commodities - weapons, for instance - past sanctions and blockades.", 0f, h, "Rayan Arroyo");
031                                
032                                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistHector")) {
033                                        tooltip.addPara("He has agreed to back Hector's Absolutist faction.", 8f, h, "Hector's");
034                                }
035                                else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistAchilles")) {
036                                        tooltip.addPara("He has agreed to back Achilles' Reformer faction.", 8f, h, "Achilles'");
037                                }
038                                else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistRebels")) {
039                                        tooltip.addPara("He has agreed to back the rebels of the United Front in their uprising against the Sindrian Diktat.", 8f, h, "United Front");
040                                }
041                        }
042                };
043        }
044
045        @Override
046        public String getProgressStr(BaseEventIntel intel) {
047//              if (getProgress(intel) <= 0) return "";
048                return super.getProgressStr(intel);
049        }
050        
051        @Override
052        public int getProgress(BaseEventIntel intel) {
053                
054                if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistHector")) 
055                {
056                        return -SDRPoints.ARROYO;
057                }
058                else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistAchilles")) 
059                {
060                        return SDRPoints.ARROYO;
061                }
062                else if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$sdr_arroyoAssistRebels")) 
063                {
064                        return SDRPoints.ARROYO;
065                }
066                
067                // if he hasn't been explicitly asked to assist, Arroyo backs no one.
068                // This shouldn't appear if PC hasn't made contact with Arroyo about this.
069                
070                return 0; // SDRPoints.ARROYO;
071        }
072
073        @Override
074        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
075                return "Arroyo's smuggling operation";
076        }
077        
078        @Override
079        public Color getDescColor(BaseEventIntel intel) {
080                if (getProgress(intel) != 0) return Misc.getTextColor();
081                return Misc.getGrayColor();
082        }
083}
